reviews.text: Great people and confident they were caring well for our dog. Scheduling was easy and very flexible

Jordan’s Pet Care is an extremely reliable dog walking service! Caleb has been walking Shadow for a couple of weeks now and is fantastic! He provides detailed updates after each walk and makes me feel like my dog is in great hands while I am at work! Thank you JPC!

Jordan’s Pet Care is absolutely incredible! We’ve been using this team for about a year now, and everyone is remarkably kind, trustworthy, and completely dependable. They easily accommodate our hectic weeks and last-minute schedule changes every single time!

Our 2-year-old Golden Retriever is a total ball of rambunctious energy, but they handle the chaos beautifully. We want to give the biggest shout-out to our regular walker, Diego, who has been a complete superstar over the last six months. Diego deserves the highest recognition and consistently goes above and beyond. Here are just a few examples:

- Tailored Care: Diego took the time to truly understand our dog's quirks and provides unmatched, personalized support.
- Brilliant Feedback: The walk reports are incredibly detailed, and Diego takes the absolute best photos of our dog!
- Active Training: When we asked to incorporate more brain work, Diego immediately started practicing training tricks mid-walk.
- Weather Thoughtful: Diego is so attentive during hot weather, making sure to stick to the shade and constantly provide water.
- Pure Kindness: Diego genuinely loves our pup, and the pure excitement from our dog every time Diego arrives says it all!

We are so incredibly grateful for Diego's amazing work!

We have been using JPC for our two cats, and we have found their service to be incredibly reliable and trustworthy. Their online portal makes everything very easy to manage — we can submit requests, provide detailed information about our cats and their routines, and give specific instructions for their care, including how to administer medication. On each visit, the sitter completes a checklist and sends us a message with photos, which gives us wonderful peace of mind while we are away. We also appreciate how well JPC communicates with us and makes sure that our instructions and any updates are clearly passed along.

But, of course, the most important part of a cat-sitting service is the quality of the person who actually comes into your home. And JPC has an amazing team of sitters.

We have two very shy kitties, and they are not easy cats to care for. One of them becomes extremely nervous when she senses that we are preparing to travel, and she has even developed stress-related blood in her urine. Our other cat is incredibly shy around strangers and will hide and refuse to come out whenever we have visitors. Because of this, having someone else care for them while we travel has always been a real challenge.

When we first stared using JPC, we would request the shortest, 30-minute visits because we were worried about putting too much stress on our cats. But Diego is different. He has a wonderful way of understanding and connecting with shy cats.

Our nervous little girl has become very comfortable with him and actually seems to enjoy her time with him. She is a very affectionate cat who loves attention once she feels safe, and it is so reassuring to know that she has someone she trusts while we are away.

Our other cat is a completely different story. She normally hides from everyone and will not come out for anyone except our family. So we were surprised when Diego told us that she actually pressed her head against his hand when he reached out to her under the sofa. She would never do something like that with a stranger. Somehow, Diego managed to win over even our most reclusive little girl!

JPC also knows how much our cats trust Diego, and whenever his schedule allows, they do their best to arrange for him to care for our cats. We really appreciate that personal touch. It shows that JPC understands its clients and cares about building long term relationships and trust.

We feel lucky to have found JPC — and especially Diego. Knowing that our two little ones are safe, comfortable, and cared for by someone they trust makes it so much easier for us to enjoy our time away. We highly recommend JPC or Diego!

Nellie’s treated so well on her walks with Patrick. She's been a loyal customer for 3+ years. JPC goes above and beyond to make my puppy feel loved and cared for. They don’t just walk my little girl, but also plays with, cleans after and refills food/water. The system for scheduling is very straightforward.

My dog loves Diego! He gets very nervous to leave the house but Diego is patient and kind with him, over time I have seen him start to let go of his fears little by little when he sees Diego. It makes me glad to know he’s happy and well cared for. I get detailed reports on the walks, and they stick to the shade, go slow and provide water on hot days. I also get photos from his walks and sometimes he gets another walking buddy which I think he really enjoys. Jordan’s pet care is quick to respond and very accommodating even on short notice, it’s a great service!

The Jordan’s Pet Care team is exceptional.  Our blind, two-year-old German Shepherd has been thriving with Taylor walking her four or more days a week for the better part of the last year. This is no small feat since she needs quite a bit of attentiveness and care on the streets of Brooklyn.  Taylor is patient and kind and reads her exceptionally well.  Not only does Taylor treat our pup like family, but so do Devon and Suki’s other walkers, Jasmine and Cat.

I started using Jordan's Pet Care a little over a month ago when I was looking for a reliable dog walker, and I couldn't be happier with the experience. Ethan is my regular walker, and he is fantastic—reliable, clearly loves dogs, and always sends detailed updates after each walk. I immediately felt like my dog was in great hands.

I recently decided to use Jordan's Pet Care for dog sitting while I was away for a week. I was initially nervous about it because I normally board my dog, but Daniel was absolutely amazing. He sent frequent updates and photos, took incredible care of my dog Vesuvius, made sure he was fed and had plenty of water, took him on long walks, and also handled his medication. It was clear that he cared for Vesuvius as if he were his own.

I also came home to my apartment looking exactly as I left it—it honestly felt like nobody had even been there. That level of care and professionalism is incredibly hard to find.

I am beyond impressed with Jordan's Pet Care and would highly recommend them. You can feel confident that your pet will receive the very best care!
Really wonderful people. Would def hire again and recommend!

I was very worried about my little guy while I'm at work. I work long hours and Jordans pet care has been a life saver. I find the scheduling and cancelling easy and quick through their app. Which works with my constantly changing shift work. It always gives me a smile when I see a mid day notification updating me on the walk with added pictures so I can see him. The entire process was very fast and professional, from me initially calling and having the meetup and scheduling done 3 days later. Overall while it's a pricey service you are getting the quality you are paying for. I really got the impression the staff and walker care about the animals they work with

Really happy with this service for my five-year-old, energetic dog. The meet and greet was simple and straightforward. I get a daily update with photos after each walk, which is nice to have. Would definitely recommend.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

Incredible service. I was leaving town in a hurry and they were able to meet my pet on a Sunday afternoon to gather notes and create a profile for her. The employees I was assigned were great and sent me updates and photos for each day. Going to use them again for sure!
Really nice and reliable people, and the prices are decent. If I had to make 1 suggestion, it's just that I wish the windows were smaller, for there was just a set time that the walker would come in.
They continue to be wonderful for years now across several pets. Such wonderful catsitters, kept our furbabies happy and healthy for 17 days away, longest we’d ever been away! I’m so grateful
Jordan is incredible. All of their Walkers and staff members take intensive care of your pet like their own. Highly recommend!
great team love them very trust worthy my lil girl dali was in good hands with them
Very happy with Jordan’s Pet Care. They take such good care of my little guy while I’m away and provide clear and consistent communication.

I have had an incredible experience with Jordan’s Pet Care. I absolutely will be using them again when I travel. They took care of my two cats while I was away for two weeks—— very professional, easy to communicate with all the caregivers, everyone was so caring and reliable. Loved receiving the daily reports and photos. Thank you JPC!
Jordan’s is the absolute best! There is no one my dog loves more than their walkers. Their communication, reliability and extraordinary care is unmatched! Couldn’t recommend more!

Jordan's Pet Care is amazing---very professional, communicative, and (most importantly) amazing with dogs. The adminstrative team always responds to messages and requests in a timely manner and the walkers are some of the best in the business. I always knew that my dog was in excellent care with her Jordan's walkers---she also always had a blast. Jordan's walkers truly went above and beyond in caring for my dog and making sure that each walk was special and safe. I cannot recommend Jordan's enough!
Highly recommend! Super professional and kind.
They took care of my cat and sent me pictures when I was away. Everyone was nice and caring. 100% use their service again next time I travel.
My dog and I love Jordan's Pet Care. They are the most professional and caring team of walkers and sitters around. Highly recommend.

I can’t recommend Jordan’s Pet Care enough. We have been with them for years over multiple apartments and neighborhoods. Our dog has had multiple health issues over the years and has required some special attention. From the office team to the walkers, everyone at Jordan’s is so considerate and caring. It means a great deal and takes a load of worry off our minds to know our dog is in such thorough, good hands when we aren’t around. They’re so good to our dog that he potentially loves them more than us :) Thank you Jordan’s! You’re the best.

I've been using Jordan's Pet Care for dog walking and dog sitting for a couple months now, as I recently adopted a rescue dog. My rescue, while incredibly sweet and harmless, can be a bit shy and unsure of new people and had minor separation anxiety when I first adopted her (though we've since worked through that). I got assigned to a regular dog walker named Patrick who has been nothing short of incredible. Throughout all of his walks with my dog, he's been so patient with her... slowly building up trust with her every single day. I recently needed to schedule dog sitting for my first overnight trip away from my dog, and I was a bit nervous leaving her for several nights. However, Patrick was able to stay with her in my apartment and I was truly blown away with how incredible the experience was. Not only did Patrick absolutely charm the socks off my dog (she had zero signs of separation anxiety), but the updates I received throughout his stay relieved my own separation anxiety! He treated my apartment as his own (in a good way lol!) and loved on my dog as if he adopted her himself. I truly was so grateful for his care and consideration. Jordan's Pet Care overall has been incredible with communication - they are so reliable and have saved me so much stress and anxiety knowing my dog is always in good hands. I highly recommend Jordan's for both dog walking and dog sitting (especially Patrick!!!)! Cannot say enough good things.
Jordan’s are the best!!!

All of the staff at Jordan’s have been great to work with.    They really care about my pup.   She’s a senior dog and they are always so considerate and patient with her.    They really look out for her and the daily updates are terrific and detailed.
Jordan's Pet Care is so easy to work with. The care is always top notch and I appreciate the updates they send.
I can't say enough about how wonderful this team is! They take incredible care of my kitties and I have so much trust in them! They are the absolute best!
They took care of my two old man cats and even visited twice a day when I asked. Communication and scheduling were great. They really provided peace of mind.

I’m so glad I found this company. I am very particular about who I trust to take care of my pups and I whole-heartedly trust Jordan’s Pet Care staff. I work very unpredictable hours so bringing them to a day care wasn’t feasible for me. I love that JPC comes to my apartment at my chosen times, and I don’t have to worry about my dogs while I’m at work. They’re so attentive to detail and the dog walkers have all built unique bonds with my dogs. Even my nervous pup gets excited to see her dog walker. Would recommend them to every busy dog owner!!

Helped me out a lot while I was recovering from surgery, making sure my dog got good, consistent walks.  Great communication, easy online booking and calendar management, helpful walk reports.  Will use again.

We have been using Jordan’s to care for our dog since moving back to Brooklyn from Texas about 4 months ago. From our first interactions over email, they have been amazingly responsive and communicative, and you can tell each and every person really loves and prioritizes providing the best care for your animal. Our dog has had 2 different main walkers (we moved apartments partway through to a different walk zone), and each has been so gentle and considerate of our pup’s particular needs. I would not hesitate to recommend their services to other pet parents.

Jordan’s Pet Care has been amazing!  They are professional, yet provide very personalized care.  I appreciated the initial in-person meet-up with my dog and me, and I love that they have many very loving Dog Walkers to care for my dog.  They have made my experience of moving to the city and finding a dog walker comforting and enjoyable.  I can’t recommend them enough!

Jordan's Pet Care is the best! You can tell they are animal lovers and they have taken such great care of my cats and dog. They have affordable walks, they are informative and send pictures each walk. They are understanding if you need to make a change. Their online scheduling platform is simple and easy to use. Highly recommend!!

A+++ service! We are so happy with Jordan’s service. Cat and Lainie take such wonderful care of our two kitties. We always feel super confident and relieved knowing that our two felines are well taken care of. The team is super fast with confirming g appointments, very clean and thorough and leave our place better than they found it.

I was nervous about finding a cat sitter for my 12 year old kitty - especially since she isn’t always the easiest kitty ;) But Jordan’s Pet Care really put my concerns at ease. After meeting the manager Devon and hearing more about their vetting and probationary process with their sitters, the history of the company/founder and general process, I really felt like these guys love animals and are super respectful of customers’ homes. Jasmine took care of my kitty and am very happy with the updates she provided while I was out of town. They will definitely be my go-to pet sitting service. Highly recommend Jordan’s Pet care!

I’ve been using Jordan’s for 3.5 years now and I can’t recommend them enough! Always on time, always send the best reports and pictures and I can tell they really care about not only my cats but all the animals they look after. It’s a great and reassuring feeling to know that my boys are in the best hands while I’m gone.

Their care team has been so easy and friendly to work with. The dog walkers treat my new (and very scared) dog with so much love and kindness. So glad I found such a great company to help out my rescue!! They give a great report after the walk too.

Best pet service ever!  I've used them for years - for dog walks and overnight pet sitting. They have taken care of multiple pets - even those with medical issues.  Reliable, easy to use, and friendly.  They have never let me down.  I could not recommend them more highly.

Excellent service - reliable and communicative. Makes traveling so much easier knowing my cats are taken care of.

2025 update: I continue to be happy with Jordan's Pet Care. They take excellent care of our clan of cats when we are out of town and are easy to schedule and work with.
Excellent communication and kind, reliable dog walkers and sitters. I trust them completely and they do a great job with my leash reactive pup.

Jordan’s Pet Care is the most reliable and caring dog walking service I’ve ever used plus their platform makes planning walks really easy and turnkey. They also send through pics of my puppy and an update from every walk via email!
I've had JPC watch my cat several times, and they always do a great job. They're kind and considerate, and I really appreciate the daily updates.
Jordan’s Pet Care are amazing cat sitters! Love trusting our little guys with them—

I can't say enough good things about Jordan's Pet care and how well they take care of my pup Gumbo.  From the start, they have been super responsive, patient, and kind with a first time puppy mom, and I'm grateful.  Gumbo loves her walker Jack, and I swear she is smiling in every update I receive when she is with him.  I love their app, ease of scheduling and canceling visits, and prompt replies to my questions.  Highly, highly recommended!

Jordan's pet care is great. All of the walkers are kind and thoughtful and really care about your pet. They're always willing to work through any mishap (missing key, pet hiding, etc) and are very communicative. I've trusted them with my dog for many years now and will continue to do so!

Total professionals - Jordan, Devon and their team (walker Caleb) have taken such consistent care and consideration for our puppy Aaron.

Super communicative and responsive to any adjustments or requests they have been an enormous help taking care of our pup. Would not hesitate to recommend, thank you again to the extraordinary team!

I have been using Jordan’s pet care service for years and could not recommend them highly enough. I have a difficult dog to walk who loves to eat everything on the street and they do great with her. They also are wonderful sitters when we go away, they take great care of my dog and are very respectful to our apartment.
Great pet care service. Everyone is so friendly and responsive. Marcus took great care of my golden retriever - was always a highlight of my day to get prompt updates about my golden.
Been using Jordan’s for years now. They’ve always done a fantastic job watching our cats!
Fantastic small local business.

I have used your services then later found out I was being lied to.

I've had my time wasted by this service doing a bait and switch by sending out one walker to meet my dogs but scheduling an entirely different person to actually walk them. When I actually tried to schedule anything with that first person, I was told they weren't available.
So everything that first person told me about their training and background and what safety precautions they use to work with dogs didn't matter because the person they did send out apparently had zero training and didn't know any of those things or how to handle large breed dogs.
I felt completely duped and tricked by Jordan and her team but I'd like to thank them for the name calling, it was a push to finally write out my complaints
Jordan's has been our go to pet sitter for over a decade. They are caring and go the extra mile to watch over the beloved furry members of our family.
Jordan's Pet Care is a great service for cat sitting!
